chunks: Abu Ali Al-Ash'ari from Muhammad ibn Abd al-Jabbar and Muhammad ibn Ismail from al-Fadl ibn Shadhan, all from Safwan ibn Yahya from Ibn Muskan from Ayoub ibn al-Hurr, who said:

Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) was asked about a man who died in a ship in the sea, how should he be dealt with? He (peace be upon him) said: 'He is placed in a barrel, its head is sealed, and it is thrown into the water.'

key_terms.خَابِيَةٍ: A barrel or large container used for burial

ai.seo_question: What is the Islamic ruling for burying a deceased person who dies at sea?
ai.summary: Recorded in al-Kafi by Shaykh al-Kulayni, this hadith from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) establishes the practical fiqh for maritime burial when reaching land is impossible, emphasizing the preservation of dignity through the use of a sealed container (khabiya). This ruling reflects the Shia scholarly principle of facilitating religious obligations according to circumstantial necessity (mukhaffafat), ensuring the deceased is treated with respect even in the vastness of the sea.
